SELECT 'VENUE' AS type, v.id AS venue_id, v.venue_name AS venue_name,
NULL AS court_id, NULL AS court_name, NULL AS court_type,
v.venue_name AS match_name, NULL AS normalized_match_name,
0 AS alias FROM venue v WHERE v.is_deleted = 0 AND v.status = 1

SELECT 'VENUE' AS type, v.id AS venue_id, v.venue_name AS venue_name,
NULL AS court_id, NULL AS court_name, NULL AS court_type,
va.alias_name AS match_name, va.normalized_alias AS normalized_match_name,
1 AS alias FROM venue_alias va INNER JOIN venue v ON va.venue_id = v.id WHERE va.enabled = 1 AND v.is_deleted = 0 AND v.status = 1

SELECT 'COURT' AS type, v.id AS venue_id, v.venue_name AS venue_name,
c.id AS court_id, c.name AS court_name, c.type AS court_type,
c.name AS match_name, NULL AS normalized_match_name,
0 AS alias FROM court c INNER JOIN venue v ON c.venue_id = v.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND v.is_deleted = 0 AND v.status = 1

SELECT 'COURT' AS type, v.id AS venue_id, v.venue_name AS venue_name,
c.id AS court_id, c.name AS court_name, c.type AS court_type,
ca.alias_name AS match_name, ca.normalized_alias AS normalized_match_name,
1 AS alias FROM court_alias ca INNER JOIN court c ON ca.court_id = c.id INNER JOIN venue v ON c.venue_id = v.id WHERE ca.enabled = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND v.is_deleted = 0 AND v.status = 1
